changes.evidence: Past group the record leaves out: X-Men: The Animated Series episodes 25-26 ('Reunion', S2 ep 12-13) tell that Magneto ruled the Savage Land from his citadel and created the Mutates (Ka-Zar resents him for meddling with the land), before Sinister took them over. He had left them before his first title, so this is a past stage ahead of the Acolytes. The dataset already uses 'The Savage Land Mutates' (Sinister, Sauron).

changes.evidence: Undercover service left out: in X-Men: The Animated Series episodes 21-22 ('Time Fugitives', S2 ep 7-8) Apocalypse disguises himself as a human scientist and poses as a Friends of Humanity member, working with Graydon Creed to spread the plague (the record's own episode 21 step says so). He slips away when the X-Men destroy the lab, and later raises Horsemen again (War and Gambit as Death in X-Men '97 S2).

owner_calls.question: In X-Men '97 episode 9, after Genosha falls, Magneto raises Asteroid M, turns on the X-Men and Xavier, and leads mutants (Rogue and Sunspot join him) to leave Earth, until Xavier breaks through to him in episode 10. The screen gives this following no group name. Should it be its own stage, or does it stay under the existing Genosha stage until the X-Men stage?
options: Keep as is (Genosha until the X-Men stage)
Add an unnamed Asteroid M stage keyed to X-Men '97 S1 (owner to name it)
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men '97 S1 episode 9: Magneto restores Asteroid M to lead mutantkind off Earth and asks the X-Men to join him; only Rogue and Sunspot do; he fights the X-Men. Episode 10: Xavier repairs his mind and he halts the asteroid.

owner_calls.question: In the X-Men '97 S2 finale's mid-credits scene, Mystique shoots Valerie Cooper and takes her identity (Cooper runs the government's X-Factor). Does assuming her place count as undercover service that should be recorded now, or wait until a later season shows her serving?
options: Add X-Factor (undercover as Cooper) keyed to X-Men '97 S2
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men '97 S2 episode 9 ('Survival of the Fittest') mid-credits: Mystique shoots Cooper and assumes her identity as Graydon Creed is elected president. No service in the role is shown yet.
